audit.whatIsWrong: The entry tells the player to 'silence him so he cannot Flamespitter', and elsewhere to 'E-shred his armor'.
audit.why: Flamespitter is not a channel — Riot's text has it 'dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds'. A silence stops the next CAST; a cone already burning keeps ticking through it. This is the Rumble-side audit's headline finding, restated from Garen's side. Separately, Judgment carries no shred flag and Riot's text is only 'dealing physical damage to nearby enemies' — Garen shreds nothing, so 'E-shred his armor' is a fabricated mechanic that appears in this entry's boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Silence blocks his next cast, not a burning cone; Judgment is flat physical damage, not a shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: Electro Harpoon's slow and MR shred are never connected to Decisive Strike, and the terrain threat from The Equalizer is unstated.
audit.why: Harpoon slows and reduces MR, and Rumble carries two charges — but Decisive Strike 'break[s] free of all slows' on a flat 8s, so the slow is answerable on demand. The MR shred does not touch Demacian Justice, which is true damage. The Equalizer lays a wall of flame across the lane and Garen has no dash (missingInteractions flags exactly this), so Flash is reserved for crossing it, not for damage.
audit.corrected: Q purges the harpoon slow; his MR shred does not raise your execute threshold; hold Flash for the fire wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart is inverted against the packet: content gives Rumble six of seven stages and the full layer gives him five, while the packet gives Garen six and Rumble only Level 6. The whys are also shifted a row — whys[3], sitting on Levels 4-5, describes the level-6 Equalizer spike.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Rumble, Garen, Garen] at a 54.37% Garen win rate. Garen closes Flamespitter's short range with Q's move speed and punishes Overheat; the single stage Rumble owns is 6, when The Equalizer first zones the all-in.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 4-5 and both item stages to Garen 6/10; Level 6 to Rumble 4/10, with the two shifted whys re-seated on their own rows.

audit.why: Garen is the aggressor: close the range, punish Overheat, concede only the Equalizer window. The early/mid/late prose says this and matches the packet.

edits.before: Track Rumble’s Scrap Shield (6s): Bait it, then commit. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Scrap Shield is a flat 6s, so it is always up — the timer that matters is Equalizer at 130s.

edits.before: Extend into his danger-zone Q. Stand in his R line. Stack pure HP. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it like the last one in stock.
edits.after: Extend into his danger-zone Q. Stand in his R line. Answer his magic with armour. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it that way.

edits.before: Track his Rumble Rumble overheat silage and Equalizer rocket trails before you commit
edits.after: Track The Equalizer (130s at rank 1) and watch his heat gauge before you commit

edits.before: Rumble's level-6 R Equalizer zones and out-trades your all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you run him down while Equalizer is not yet online.

edits.before: With his ult on cooldown your Q-silence and E-shred retake control.
edits.after: At 6 his R Equalizer fire strip zones you out of the all-in.

edits.before: You win the melee range war: close with Q Decisive Strike's move-speed boost, silence him so he cannot Flamespitter or Scrap Shield away, and spin E while he overheats. A Rumble stuck at max heat loses his damage and moves slowly - punish it.
edits.after: You win the melee range war: Decisive Strike's move-speed burst closes the gap and purges his Electro Harpoon slow, and the silence blocks his next cast — a Flamespitter already burning still ticks 3 seconds. A Rumble at max heat cannot cast at all: punish it.

edits.before: Once his Equalizer is down you re-take control: Q-silence through his shield, E-shred his armor, and Perseverance out-sustains his short-range Flamespitter poke.
edits.after: Once his Equalizer is down you re-take control: Q purges his harpoon slow, Judgment grinds him through Scrap Shield, and Perseverance out-sustains his short-range poke.

notes: Mirror consistency: this restates the Rumble-side audit's headline — Decisive Strike's silence stops a CAST, not a Flamespitter cone that is already burning for its 3 seconds — from Garen's side, so neither page contradicts the other. Second champion-level finding worth a sweep: 'Judgment ... shred their armor' appears in the generated boilerplate (tradeGood, breakdown.trading, dosFull[2].d, report[3].t) across every Garen matchup I have audited, and Judgment has no shred in Riot's data. I corrected it only where it sat in editable prose here; a champion-level pass should remove it everywhere. Packet suspectName "Decisive Strike's" is a FALSE POSITIVE — it is the real Q name with a possessive. Level chart proposed as one atomic group, including the two whys that were seated on the wrong rows.
